title: Choosing -nsa or -nsä
focus: The third-person ending has two vowel-harmony forms, -nsa and -nsä. Choose it from the noun’s vowels, not from hänen or heidän.

exercises.prompt: Choose the final vowel in “his ball”: hänen pallons_. Use pallo (“ball”).
exercises.explanation: Use a: pallo becomes pallonsa. A back vowel a, o, or u requires -nsa. Choose from the noun, not the owner pronoun.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Third-person possessive vowel harmony: form or meaning confused

optionFeedback.a: Use a: pallo becomes pallonsa. A back vowel a, o, or u requires -nsa. Choose from the noun, not the owner pronoun.
optionFeedback.ä: Use ä when there is no back vowel: front vowels or only neutral e and i take -nsä.

exercises.prompt: Choose the final vowel in “his pen”: hänen kynäns_. Use kynä (“pen”).
exercises.explanation: Use ä: kynä becomes kynänsä. With no back vowel, front vowels or only neutral e and i require -nsä. Choose from the noun, not the owner pronoun.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Third-person possessive vowel harmony: form or meaning confused

optionFeedback.a: Use a only when the noun contains a back vowel a, o, or u.
optionFeedback.ä: Use ä: kynä becomes kynänsä. With no back vowel, front vowels or only neutral e and i require -nsä. Choose from the noun, not the owner pronoun.

exercises.prompt: Repair “heidän kissansä” for “their cat”. Choose harmony from kissa (“cat”), retaining the owner.
exercises.explanation: heidän + kissa + -nsa gives heidän kissansa. Choose harmony from the noun’s vowels, not the owner pronoun.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Third-person possessive vowel harmony: form or meaning confused

optionFeedback.heidän kissansa: heidän + kissa + -nsa gives heidän kissansa. Choose harmony from the noun’s vowels, not the owner pronoun.
optionFeedback.heidän kissansä: This final vowel disagrees with the noun vowels; the owner pronoun does not decide harmony.
optionFeedback.heidän kissa: This omits the third-person possessive ending.
